name: Shelf sea
notes: Open continental-shelf water: no land plants; the shoreline where the shelf sea meets the coast carries eelgrass, saltmarsh cordgrass and strandline weed, and the seabed carries seagrass and brown algae in the photic zone. Drawn on North Sea/Baltic, NW Atlantic (Georges Bank), and Australian shelf; underwater species flagged.
